pr_title: Fix hunt incorrectly pathing to uncrushable targets
pr_body:
Fixes #20969

For the testcase see the map provided in the issue

issue_context.title: Hunt activity can't pathfind around actors
issue_context.body:
It's a decently sized issue in campaign, AI's units tend to get stuck sometimes.

To reproduce start a game with this [testcse map](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/files/12103543/test.oramap.zip)

![huntgrafic](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/assets/37534529/c8ae8df1-5cee-434d-95a1-bf8e2ab74799)
comments: The issue lies in that the cell the target is on is blocked by the target, meaning the only valid pathfinding layer remains the layer that ignores actors

review_comments: Is that correct for isometric mods as well?
`readonly WDist minTargetRange = WDist.FromCells(2);` might be more descriptive. Can `range.Length` be negative? If so this might need `.LengthSquared` instead.

I think with the comment explaining it it's fairly clear

I also can't find any checks for negative range or negative range modifiers, though it's not unlikely our entire codebase would collapse if they appeared.

I was thinking from the player's perspective, and that range are not two cells horizontally or vertically on isometric mods. But I guess since this is actually just important for the pathfinding it doesn't matter. (And you could make the same argument for going two cells diagonally in the normal grid mods.)
